column5: SceneObject slots 27-2E 35 37 (frames, play, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick incl. the Cannon's play and tick, stop, getTimerId, isRunning), AnimationVtbl playOnce, animation_set_strip
the WinG shell: WinMain, app_init, AppWndProc (create, destroy, activate, 0x40b hello / 0x40c ready; no WM_PAINT wave), message loop
Backdrop/GridBackdrop (one WinG bitmap), InvBackdrop's ctor and create (32-px grid, no wall cells), the occupancy grid and its queries
DIB loading, copies and the row blitters (1000 is NOITE's byte-identical 32-bit segment)
InvGame: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (createPlayer: the cannon, 4 lives; panel, status bar, init scene, onCreate: the six creators), game_init, game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00, 3.7 KB: the engine default under the INV handler, which takes every input) and the Portable pick-up/drop it calls
the formation: the 4 invader columns and the explosion (creation, start right), InvaderVtbl step, the turn, lowestAlive, the explosion's start

InvScene: its handler (keys, every WM_SYSTIMER, the hit tests, the speed-up, the end, WM_DESTROY and 0x40a; BUGS.md I1, I2), create (MCI, WaveMix, the 8 waves, the score), createScreen, cannon_lose_life
ObjectList, DrawList, UpdateList (out of line in INV) and message_box_printf (the shared g_messageText)
the shot and the 2 bombs: creation (the null-pointer writes, BUGS.md INV Harmless), MissileVtbl armTimer and moveTick, shot_vanish, bomb_shot_down

SceneObject slots 2F-34 36 (moveTo, edges, stopMoving(Dc) incl. the Saucer's, the Missile's and the InvaderColumn's (right-edge descent, landing), moveTick incl. the Missile's and the InvaderColumn's, isMoving)

constructors and destructors of the objects (Cannon, Saucer, Missile/Bomb/Shot, InvaderColumn and its cells, InvaderExplosion, Player2D/Actor2D/Mover/Animation, InvPanel/ControlPanel/Animated3D/Object3D, StatusBar, SceneObject) and frames

SceneObject slots 22-26 (occupy, vacate, attach, canStep incl. the Cannon's, the Missile's and the InvaderColumn's, isStepBlocked), reattach, and Mover placeAt (slot 00 of MoverVtbl, SaucerVtbl, MissileVtbl, InvaderVtbl)
the ControlPanel/InvPanel and StatusBar methods (ControlPanelVtbl 01-08), draw, tick, inventory icons; created and attached, never shown
SceneObject slots 08-0C getX/getY/getStep, 39 setPosition, 4C unk4E, 4E/4F overlap tests, 50/51 54/55 defaults; the /Od out-of-line accessors (hit box, frame, size); next_object_id
SceneObject slots 12-1A (dirty rects, overlap, restore background incl. the InvaderColumn's and InvaderExplosion's, drawDirtyTo, draw incl. theirs, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F) and the DC hooks
the saucer: creation, SaucerVtbl armTimer (the 10 s launch) and checkEdge, saucer_explode
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0C), ctors (InvScene's too), scene_create and the destructor, exits
g_score and the waves: the 8 wave helpers (+100 invader, +500 saucer, -500 cannon), the score box (inv_draw_score, inv_blit_score_box)
WaveMix (the eight INV waves)
SceneObject slots 00-07 0D-11 38 (Object3D getters/setters, drawBounds), the Object3DVtbl slots, the perspective math
SceneObject slots 1B-21 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc incl. the Cannon's, invalidate, slot24, hide, show) and 4D redrawOverlapping
